description: This file defines the 'Value' struct and associated methods for representing and manipulating structured telemetry data values, including serialization/deserialization to JSON, and various constructors for different data types.

classes.name: Value
classes.description: Represents a structured telemetry value with methods for creation, comparison, serialization, and type conversion.

methods.name: StringValue
methods.description: Creates a new Value holding a string.

methods.name: IntValue
methods.description: Creates a new Value holding an int, converted to int64.

methods.name: Int64Value
methods.description: Creates a new Value holding an int64.

methods.name: Float64Value
methods.description: Creates a new Value holding a float64.

methods.name: BoolValue
methods.description: Creates a new Value holding a bool.

methods.name: BytesValue
methods.description: Creates a new Value holding a byte slice.

methods.name: SliceValue
methods.description: Creates a new Value holding a slice of Values.

methods.name: MapValue
methods.description: Creates a new Value holding a map of Attrs.

methods.name: AsString
methods.description: Returns the string held by the Value.

methods.name: asString
methods.description: Returns the string held by the Value; panics if not a string.

methods.name: AsInt64
methods.description: Returns the int64 held by the Value.

methods.name: asInt64
methods.description: Returns the int64 held by the Value; may return garbage if wrong type.

methods.name: AsBool
methods.description: Returns the bool held by the Value.

methods.name: asBool
methods.description: Returns the bool held by the Value; may return garbage if wrong type.

methods.name: AsFloat64
methods.description: Returns the float64 held by the Value.

methods.name: asFloat64
methods.description: Returns the float64 held by the Value; may return garbage if wrong type.

methods.name: AsBytes
methods.description: Returns the byte slice held by the Value.

methods.name: asBytes
methods.description: Returns the byte slice held by the Value; panics if not bytes.

methods.name: AsSlice
methods.description: Returns the slice of Values held by the Value.

methods.name: asSlice
methods.description: Returns the slice of Values; panics if not a slice.

methods.name: AsMap
methods.description: Returns the map of Attrs held by the Value.

methods.name: asMap
methods.description: Returns the map of Attrs; panics if not a map.

methods.name: Kind
methods.description: Returns the ValueKind of the Value.

methods.name: Empty
methods.description: Checks if the Value is empty (no value).

methods.name: Equal
methods.description: Checks if the Value is equal to another Value.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the Value for debugging.

methods.name: MarshalJSON
methods.description: Serializes the Value into JSON in OTLP format.

methods.name: UnmarshalJSON
methods.description: Deserializes JSON data into the Value.
